groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Also known as Agenda. Golang/Rust RaaS active since July 2022 and one of the most prolific leak sites of 2025–26; double extortion. Posted ten victims across six countries today, mostly SMEs, all with bare "N/A" descriptions.
groups.countries: United Kingdom (3), Brazil, France, Germany, Mexico, Portugal, Singapore, Türkiye
groups.sectors: Education, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Not disclosed, Other, Professional Services

groups.name: MetaEncryptor
groups.profile: Data-leak and encryption crew active since 2024. Today's batch of seven leans on Korean industrial names plus three US firms.

groups.name: N0n
groups.profile: Posts detailed data-inventory teasers stamped "[NOT PAID — EXPOSED]" alongside anonymised "Company #N" placeholders marked "[PENDING EXPOSURE]". Four named victims today; ten more "Company #138–147" placeholders (US, Canada, South Korea retail/finance) were excluded as masked.

groups.name: Payload
groups.profile: Leak site tracked by both aggregators; today's four postings are German SMEs published in one batch with AI-style company descriptions and no data volumes.
groups.sectors: Business Services, Professional Services, Retail & E-Commerce, Transportation

groups.name: Nightspire
groups.profile: Extortion group seen since early 2025, reported to exploit edge-device (FortiOS) vulnerabilities. Today's three postings appear only on RansomLook, with no country or sector data.

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS since May 2023; phishing and Cobalt Strike for access; auctions stolen data. Today hit a Brazilian state court and a Swiss fiduciary/real-estate firm.

groups.name: Anubis
groups.profile: RaaS seen since late 2024, notable for an optional file-wiping mode. One posting today with a terse "fertilizer, grain" teaser.

groups.name: SafePay
groups.profile: Emerged late 2024 and became one of 2025's most active leak sites; runs without a public affiliate programme and has been reported to enter via VPN/RDP credentials. Today: one Israeli education organisation posted as a bare domain.

groups.name: SilentRansomGroup
groups.profile: Also known as Luna Moth / Chatty Spider; callback-phishing data-extortion crew focused on US law firms.

groups.name: Whitearmor
groups.profile: New data-theft/extortion DLS, first victim claimed 21 Oct 2026. RedPacket flags reports of unverified or fabricated claims.
